Path: changing a running app without code | studio-authoring.expression-editors | P1

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx` (flags from `options` alone) and `previews/useObjectOptions.ts` (failure indistinguishable from an empty catalog) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: while the roster loads or after it fails, every selected object is flagged "(not published)" and the author is told to publish one — breaking the objectui#8862 / #9651 rule that only an answered roster may flag. Misleading designer text ⇒ p3.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T12:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: `useObjectOptions` reports failure distinctly; flag only on an answered roster; pin the three states as `ViewColumnInspector.rosterFailure` does. The two other options-only readers (`ActionDefaultInspector`, `PageBlockInspector`) go in the same PR if the census confirms the same shape.

Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5832074369
Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T12:32Z: no open PR touches `previews/useObjectOptions.ts` or any of the three inspectors. `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test`: NOT GOVERNED. Census correction to the card body (the seat's own): `previews/useObjectOptions.ts` has three callers on main (`ActionDefaultInspector`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `PageBlockInspector`). `DatasetDefaultInspector` and `ViewVariantInspector` import a different hook of the same name, from `inspectors/useDatasetFields.ts`.

`Clause-②: no` — a designer inspector stops flagging objects before the roster answers; no export, schema or accept set moves.
